# gowgpu

> WebGPU for Go over Vulkan, Metal, DX12, OpenGL and the browser's WebGPU. Module github.com/roffe/gowgpu, package wgpu. Uses cgo for native calls.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/roffe/gowgpu/blob/main/README.md): what it is, backends, building, known issues
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/roffe/gowgpu/blob/main/AGENTS.md): notes for AI coding agents
- [Architecture](https://github.com/roffe/gowgpu/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [API reference](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/roffe/gowgpu)
